title: How fast each plan gets an answer
description: hours to first reply · silhouette = where tickets pile up · paper tick = median

props.name: data
props.description: Plan labels, observed reply times in hours and a positive Gaussian bandwidth in hours. Missing, negative or nonfinite observations are omitted; invalid bandwidths make that plan unavailable. Width is normalized within each plan, and the upper-middle observation supplies its median.

props.name: height
props.description: Optional total component height in pixels; otherwise retains the original plot proportions.

props.name: width
props.description: Optional fixed width in pixels; otherwise fills its containing element.

props.name: animate
props.description: Enable token-timed motion subject to the system reduced-motion preference.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes on the component container.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible description of what this instance measures.
